requirements.summary: LR returns the word and reserves it; an SC with a valid reservation for its address writes and returns zero.

An SC returns a nonzero value and writes nothing without a reservation, after a second SC, at another address, after a reset, and after a store, a successful SC or an AMO of the other hart into the reservation set.
Each AMO returns the old word and writes the result of its function; nothing is taken between its read and its write.
A response waits until its hart takes it, and that hart is not served meanwhile; reset drops reservations, responses and an AMO in progress.
The outcomes of the two-hart programs are those of the abstract model: no lost increment with the LR/SC lock, the LR/SC loop or AMOADD; a lost increment without them.
